subject: nonwearFilter and qwindow with activity log

messages.author: 94ceb93e0c5036f3
messages.subject: nonwearFilter and qwindow with activity log
parts:
Hello to the GGIR community and a very special hello to Vincent,
I am currently working on evaluating sleep data. With some people, I have the problem that some non-wear times are recognised during sleep. I was able to reduce the problem somewhat by using the parameters:
nonwear_approach = 2013,
timethreshold = c(10),

However, this still occurs occasionally. For a single person with regular bedtimes, the approach using:
nonwearFiltermaxHours = c(1),
nonwearFilterWindow = c(22,6)
--> This would add all times marked as nonwear, which are shorter than one hour and between 10 p.m. and 6 a.m., to the sleep.

However, since I have a large data set to evaluate and not all have regular bedtimes, the approach using qwindow is useful here. Here I load an activity log in which the sleeping times are indicated. For this I then only use :
nonwearFiltermaxHours = c(1),
qwindow = ‘C:/GENEActiv/data/Test/Guider_pro21.csv’,

I would expect that on nights when the time of falling asleep and waking up is known, no non-wear areas of less than one hour are detected.
However, non-wear areas are detected despite the diary. What am I doing wrong?

Unfortunately, I cannot provide the.BIN file, but I can provide the activity diary and the script (see attachment).

Just a brief comment:
- As date format I had used first YYYY-mm-dd, as recommended under  Advanced sleep log . But  qwindow can't handle that, it expects dd-mm-YYYY. This format is also handled by Advanced sleep log. It would be nice if the intelligent function of date format recognition could also be transferred to qwindow (I know it's a volunteer project, so not as a demand, but just as a hint).
- According to the description, the advanced sleep log requires the column name onset for the sleep onset time, but (as I have tried) it also works with sleeponset. However, sleeponset is required under qwindow for qwindow, but I am not sure whether the simple onset would also suffice here. The function descriptions are not quite identical here, which would be advantageous for using the advanced sleeplog under qwindow to exclude incorrectly detected non-wear times at night.

I look forward to your answers!
Thank you very much,
Maximilian

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] nonwearFilter and qwindow with activity log
parts:
I think you forgot to specify qwindow_dateformat. Not specifying the date format correctly will make it impossible for GGIR to use the activity diary. GGIR should provide a warning when the date format is not recognised, please confirm.

If you do not want GGIR to use the activity log to run day segment analysis make sure the activity log file name has "onlyfilter" or "filteronly" in the filename as explained here.

Best,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
